top_stories.title: Bitcoin Surges Past $81,000 Amid Regulatory and Fed Rate Optimism
points: Bitcoin broke above $81,000, a significant price milestone.

Decrypt attributes the surge to Fed Governor Christopher Waller signaling support for pausing rate hikes, which liquidated $415 million in short positions (bets that prices will fall) in a single day.
Bitcoin Magazine attributes the rally to lawmakers pushing the Senate to advance the CLARITY Act, a regulatory framework aiming to give the crypto industry legal certainty.
BTC-related stocks rallied alongside bitcoin's price increase, signaling broader market confidence.

unique_angles.point: Lawmakers are actively pressing the Senate to advance the CLARITY Act, indicating growing political support for crypto regulatory clarity in Congress.
CME FedWatch probability of no rate change jumped from 37% to 59% overnight after Waller's comments, while the 25 basis point (0.25%) hike probability collapsed from 63.2% to 42%.
This reverses a hawkish move from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech the prior week, which had knocked Bitcoin below $77,000.
The August jobs report due Friday is the last major economic data point before the Fed's September 15-16 meeting, where it will decide whether to hold, raise, or cut rates.

items.title: Banking Sector Moves into Stablecoin Race
points: A consortium of 21 major banks including Goldman Sachs and Bank of America plans to jointly launch a U.S. dollar stablecoin (a cryptocurrency pegged to and backed by dollar reserves) by early 2027, with a euro version to follow.
Kraken exchange will list SoFi's SoFiUSD stablecoin and integrate SoFi's banking network, letting Kraken Prime (an institutional trading product) execute trades for SoFi customers.
These moves show traditional finance institutions building direct crypto footholds rather than just offering custody or indirect exposure.

items.title: Regulatory Battles Continue Over Crypto Derivatives
points: The CFTC asked a judge to dismiss CME's lawsuit challenging approval of Kalshi's Bitcoin perpetual futures contract (a leveraged bet on Bitcoin's price movement), arguing CME must show concrete financial harm to sue.

A Michigan judge barred Kalshi's prediction market platform from operating sports betting, calling it a betting operation "masquerading as an investment opportunity" and threatening $500,000 daily fines for violations.
Regulatory definitions of which crypto trading products count as derivatives versus gambling or securities remain contested and inconsistent across jurisdictions.

issues.subject: Bitcoin Breaks $81K as Washington Moves on CLARITY

headlines: Bitcoin surged past $81,000 as lawmakers pushed the Senate to advance the CLARITY Act, a regulatory framework for cryptocurrency that could provide legal certainty for the industry.
BTC-related stocks rallied in tandem with bitcoin's price increase, signaling market confidence tied to potential legislative progress.

points: 1. Bitcoin broke above $81,000, marking a significant price milestone during a period of regulatory optimism.
2. The rally extended beyond spot bitcoin to related equity investments, suggesting broader market confidence in cryptocurrency's institutional adoption.

sections.title: CLARITY Act Legislative Push
points: 1. The CLARITY Act represents Washington's attempt to establish clear regulatory rules for cryptocurrency, addressing years of regulatory ambiguity.
2. Lawmakers are actively pressing the Senate to advance the legislation, indicating growing political support for crypto regulatory clarity in Congress.

issues.subject: Fed hints crush Bitcoin short bets 🏛️

headlines: Bitcoin surged to $81,000 as Fed Governor Christopher Waller signaled support for pausing rate hikes, liquidating $415 million in short positions (bets that prices will fall) in a single day.
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole speech last week knocked Bitcoin below $77,000, but Waller's dovish comments Thursday reversed that momentum ahead of the September 15-16 Fed meeting.
August jobs report due Friday is now the last major economic data before the Fed decides whether to hold, raise, or cut interest rates at its mid-September meeting.
Goldman Sachs, Bank of America, and 19 other banks are jointly launching a U.S. dollar stablecoin (a cryptocurrency pegged to the dollar) targeting early 2027 with a euro version to follow.
Kraken crypto exchange will list SoFiUSD stablecoin and integrate SoFi's banking network, giving retail traders access to institutional settlement infrastructure.

sections.title: Fed Rate Expectations Shift Sharply on Waller's Comments
points: CME FedWatch probability of no rate change jumped from 37% to 59% overnight after Waller said he'd support holding rates steady if inflation continues improving.
The 25 basis point (0.25%) hike bucket collapsed from 63.2% to 42% probability, a dramatic reversal of expectations.
This marks a sharp about-face from Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole keynote address the previous week, which had signaled the Fed might stay aggressive on rates.

sections.title: Banking Sector Moves into Stablecoin Race
points: A consortium of 21 major banks including Goldman Sachs and Bank of America plans to launch a U.S. dollar stablecoin (digital currency fully backed by dollars in reserve) by the first half of 2027.
Kraken exchange is integrating with SoFi's banking and stablecoin infrastructure, allowing Kraken Prime (an institutional trading product) to execute trades for SoFi customers using SoFiUSD.
These moves represent traditional finance institutions establishing direct footholds in the crypto ecosystem rather than just offering custody or indirect exposure.

A Michigan judge barred Kalshi prediction market platform from operating sports betting, calling it a betting operation "masquerading as an investment opportunity" and threatening $500,000 daily fines for violations.
